problem: The permanent trusted gate must not require a second human GitHub account or any other mandatory human approval. The legacy base policy self-locked the migration, so repository protection was disabled once by the owner solely to land the autonomous policy and remove the temporary bootstrap workflow in the same migration.

decision.rationale: Preserve base-authoritative CI evidence enforcement while making the permanent BeBee workflow fully autonomous. The one-time repository-settings unlock is migration-only; the resulting policy contains no mandatory human reviewer, milestone approval, or second-account dependency.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Required status checks should use unique job names; the permanent configuration therefore keeps only the trusted workflow for validate-pr-evidence.

alternatives.reason: Conflicts with the required fully autonomous agent workflow and creates an operational dependency unrelated to evidence quality.
A candidate-controlled workflow with the same required context would weaken the permanent trust boundary and create ambiguous status-check ownership.
The owner disabled repository protection once to break the legacy self-lock; the migration then removes the bootstrap and lands the autonomous trusted policy directly.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The trusted policy contains no mandatory independent human GitHub approval for governance, milestones, CI, or merge progress.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: check_trust_boundary.py, pr-evidence-trusted.yml, DECISIONS.md and the PR template define machine-enforced evidence and optional human review only.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The permanent workflow remains base-authoritative and never executes candidate policy code as authority.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: pr-evidence-trusted.yml retains separate trusted/candidate checkouts and executes validators from trusted/.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The temporary bootstrap workflow is absent from the merged result.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: .github/workflows/pr-evidence.yml is deleted in this migration before merge.

automated: Candidate policy tests and evidence checks were exercised during the migration; permanent enforcement is provided by the base-authoritative trusted workflow after merge.
manual: The owner performed the single migration-only repository-settings unlock needed to escape the legacy human self-lock.

governance.trust_boundary_change: Removes all mandatory human dependencies while preserving base-authoritative policy execution and machine-readable evidence gates.
governance.bypass_analysis: Candidate policy cannot become trusted authority within the same protected PR. Reference diversity, diff classification, official-doc parsing, same-PR governance evidence and previous-base adversarial tests remain enforced. The candidate-controlled bootstrap workflow is removed from the final state.
governance.rollback: Revert the migration commit to restore the prior policy. Do not restore the candidate-controlled bootstrap workflow as a permanent required-status provider.

known_limitations: Repository ruleset strict/up-to-date enforcement must be re-enabled after this migration, with zero required approvals and validate-pr-evidence as the required status check.
